g.text: MomToxicated: About yesterday, Drifter.

g.title: j3007731034
g.text: PapaPolar: my cue to eff off?

g.title: j3952291592
g.text: MomToxicated: About yesterday, Drifter.

g.title: j3919485865->j3952291592
g.text: true

g.title: j3204500462
g.text: PapaPolar: ghnnghk.

g.title: j3919485865->j3204500462
g.text: false

g.title: j3900490369
g.text: MomToxicated: Your cue to "eff" off.

g.title: j116540134
g.text: Don't worry about it.

g.title: j544648910
g.text: Yeah?

g.title: j1943603045
g.text: Still feel like you won?

g.title: j1726804864
g.text: Lol. You okay over there?

g.title: j2290243133
g.text: PapaPolar: what a lovely day to go for a stroll and... smell the efervon.

g.title: j569427138
g.text: MomToxicated: No. I feel like it needs to be said:

g.title: j1595681570
g.text: MomToxicated: I feel like this needs to be said:

g.title: j2186145708
g.text: PapaPolar: oh i won, you should see the other guy. lol

g.title: j21750446
g.text: PapaPolar: i'd say i'm gettin' too old for this shit, but i ain't ever gonna get any older, am i? lmao

g.title: j3206647503
g.text: So. Yeah. About... what you said.

g.title: j1066271438
g.text: What's up?

g.title: j3950575824
g.text: MomToxicated: You are not responsible for fixing everyone's problems.

g.title: j3696029144
g.text: PapaPolar: got some vague memories of arthur 'n me singing show tunes. did that actually happen?

g.title: j2863694557
g.text: MomToxicated: I shouldn't have written that.

g.title: j1089494582
g.text: MomToxicated: If you choose to carry that burden, it is... honorable. Noble. The mark of a leader. But it shouldn't be *expected* of you.

g.title: j179628691
g.text: MomToxicated: Oh, it happened. The entire first act of Soonerland.

g.title: j3341272524
g.text: Why not?

g.title: j1256279386
g.text: Is that not how you actually feel?

g.title: j3363676395
g.text: MomToxicated: I know how exhausting it can be, trust me. To shoulder that weight and responsibility.

g.title: j619764123
g.text: PapaPolar: *niiiice*

g.title: j2995875271
g.text: MomToxicated: The simple fact of the matter is, Velimir and I are adults.

g.title: j142943933
g.text: MomToxicated: No. The truth has nothing to do with it.

g.title: j2576403574
g.text: MomToxicated: What I'm saying here, in short, is this -

g.title: j1964979618
g.text: MomToxicated: Not for those of us within earshot.

g.title: j866573229
g.text: MomToxicated: And you shouldn't be required, or expected, to fix everyone's problems.

g.title: j4274079971
g.text: MomToxicated: Don't feel obligated to "fix" whatever you feel is broken between Velimir and I.

g.title: j2165147772
g.text: PapaPolar: oh c'mon, free floor show! the lil 'tannie boy wasn't half bad if my blurry recollection serves me right

g.title: j3895219360
g.text: MomToxicated: Especially not for a pair of sad, old assholes like us.

g.title: j1887975339
g.text: MomToxicated: Some things are not your responsibility in this world.

g.title: j41885677
g.text: PapaPolar: and i have it on good authority that i have a decent singing voice myself.

g.title: j3055685766
g.text: If you say so. But going around helping people through their problems seems to be how we're going to beat this thing.

g.title: j1002420533
g.text: No, stop. Go back. You said Velimir is in love with the idea of being in love. I want to dig into that.

g.title: j630106282
g.text: I guess. But I think you really need to cut Velimir some more slack. He's trying his best.

g.title: j1571443785
g.text: PapaPolar: M.

g.title: j3492898329
g.text: I'm glad I missed out, I don't know if my eardrums could have taken it.

g.title: j985114027
g.text: Oh yeah? Who told you that?

g.title: j1779940067
g.text: I feel like I missed out.

g.title: j2162558125
g.text: MomToxicated: Therapy sessions with a time-traveling victim of a catastrophe in space are the key to defeating a murderous, soul-sucking god of the Void?

g.title: j1625650301
g.text: MomToxicated: What about it?

g.title: j588422353
g.text: MomToxicated: I have been putting up with "his best" for years, dear.

g.title: j2546430490
g.text: MomToxicated: What? You want to make this poor person, who has plenty of their OWN problems to deal with, to play our therapist?!

g.title: j914415577
g.text: MomToxicated: It was... something, that's for sure.

g.title: j2867951022
g.text: PapaPolar: hmmm I wonder :-B

g.title: j4068247125
g.text: That's a little reductive. But. Maybe. Kind of. Yes.

g.title: j2440460511
g.text: ...Well, when you say it like that, it sounds ridiculous.

g.title: j1232935401
g.text: Do you honestly think that Velimir doesn't really love you?

g.title: j3239634630
g.text: You really think your whole marriage was based on a lie?

g.title: j2536731546
g.text: Why do you think that way?

g.title: j4050307378
g.text: MomToxicated: It starts as charming. Funny. Why would anyone ever get frustrated with someone like that?

g.title: j2018213059
g.text: PapaPolar: i'm not saying that. don't put words in my mouth.

g.title: j1487746765
g.text: PapaPolar: hey, we were having fun. nobody got hurt. that boy deserves to cut loose when he can.

g.title: j570975574
g.text: MomToxicated: Sigh. That was a long time ago, Velimir.

g.title: j3410083419
g.text: MomToxicated: You're starting to make me wish I was back in Uyrtichesko.

g.title: j1487940826
g.text: MomToxicated: I believe that he believes he loves me.

g.title: j2001040403
g.text: MomToxicated: Velimir is a serial optimist. He lies to himself about the state of the world around him.

g.title: j1070485887
g.text: MomToxicated: Because it never takes accountability.

g.title: j1450574876
g.text: MomToxicated: Then what is it? What were you going to say, Velimir? Let me guess. If it wasn't about asking for help, it was going to be a stupid joke at my expense.

g.title: j1413761450
g.text: PapaPolar: it was nice to spend time with somebody who wasn't embarrassed by me for a change.

g.title: j1129650535
g.text: PapaPolar: doesn't feel that long for me. but i guess that's the problem.

g.title: j711813401
g.text: MomToxicated: I'm going to go for a walk. Need to clear my head.

g.title: j3055245046
g.text: So you think he's lying to himself, too.

g.title: j3240354475
g.text: Minerva. Throw me a bone.

g.title: j853158694
g.text: MomToxicated: Always trying to see the best in people, all the time, everywhere.

g.title: j707604667
g.text: MomToxicated: Never takes responsibility. Never faces conflict.

g.title: j1134195657
g.text: PapaPolar: never mind.

g.title: j4194096363
g.text: MomToxicated: That was uncalled for.

g.title: j4222710934
g.text: MomToxicated: Vel. Look, I...

g.title: j4039622179
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j458242159
g.text: MomToxicated: He's a serial optimist. He lies to himself about the state of the world around him.

g.title: j416170007
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3240487508
g.text: MomToxicated: But that requires blinding himself to everything else.

g.title: j1182036099
g.text: MomToxicated: Sometimes you don't need a laugh. Or a smile. You need someone willing to FACE the problem and help you FIX IT.

g.title: j2215328668
g.text: MomToxicated: Go on. Say it.

g.title: j4152196029
g.text: PapaPolar: was it?

g.title: j2877877625
g.text: PapaPolar: no, no. not your fault. we've been through this a thousand times, and it's not on you to go through it again.

g.title: Chat ends. Next chat will be MinVelRank4Convo3.
g.text: Chat ends. Next chat will be MinVelRank4Convo3.

g.title: j4039622179->Chat ends. Next chat will be MinVelRank4Convo3.
j4032272761
g.text: MomToxicated: Sorry. When you're trained to be secretive, it's a hard reflex to give up sometimes.

g.title: j2968486546
g.text: MomToxicated: Otherwise his worldview would shatter. And he would have to face the fact that maybe, just maybe...

g.title: j2697153331
g.text: MomToxicated: Someone willing to help you CARRY IT.

g.title: j3302363757
g.text: PapaPolar: no.

g.title: j1635490139
g.text: PapaPolar: sorry. that's the hangover talking. guess i just sometimes wish you still laughed at my antics.

g.title: j2752946976
g.text: PapaPolar: i gotta go walk off this headache. or eat some greasy food. or puke. or all three. haven't decided what or in what order.

g.title: j287365933
g.text: MomToxicated: All the people in his life he believed were the amazing, unflinching, unstoppable moral forces he thought they were?

g.title: j3765448858
g.text: MomToxicated: I know you likely think I'm a bitch. But you're missing out on the decades of "his best" that I've had to clean up after.

g.title: j418199677
g.text: MomToxicated: Why?

g.title: j4113241926
g.text: PapaPolar: you kids have fun talking shit about me while i'm gone.

g.title: j2549196903
g.text: MomToxicated: Aren't.

g.title: j2758987354
g.text: MomToxicated: And the exhaustion that comes with.

g.title: j1406281303
g.text: MomToxicated: Go on. Won't be the first or last time you've made light of the situation at my expense.

g.title: j1657800311
g.text: ... Minerva? What was he referencing when he said "you've been through this a thousand times?"

g.title: j1191415195
g.text: I feel like I'm going to say this a lot. But. Um. Yikes.

g.title: j3134455143
g.text: So you think that... he's in love with the ideal of you, but not the real you?

g.title: j3924458102
g.text: And you think he put those beliefs onto you?

g.title: j2606541687
g.text: Boolean VelimirBurdenM is now true.

g.title: j632231858
g.text: MomToxicated: Fine. I'll say it for you.

g.title: j835876161
g.text: MomToxicated: He isn't "over" our marriage. Over... me, I suppose.

g.title: j1110021474
g.text: MomToxicated: I'm sorry you keep having to be a witness to this. It isn't fair to dump all of it on your doorstep.

g.title: j3465983578
g.text: MomToxicated: Picture in your head what you think of when you think of a "good wife."

g.title: j773990920
g.text: MomToxicated: "Why not talk this through with our new friend? I'm pretty sure the corner shrink got blown up last week, so it's not like we have any other option!"

g.title: j3453849396
g.text: And how do you feel about it?

g.title: j700714157
g.text: You suppose?

g.title: j2551773079
g.text: It's starting to feel like my job. Lol.

g.title: j3610951337
g.text: Is there anything I can do to help?

g.title: j965838186
g.text: MomToxicated: Not even talking a traditional, barefoot in the kitchen, pregnant wife.

g.title: j2359833111
g.text: MomToxicated: Was that it?

g.title: j325558283
g.text: MomToxicated: Do you want to know Sol's honest truth?

g.title: j2166285246
g.text: MomToxicated: Doesn't make it right. You didn't ask for this. You certainly have your own nonsense to deal with.

g.title: j4074589854
g.text: MomToxicated: I honestly don't know. I don't think so. The issue is... well?

g.title: j3697598391
g.text: MomToxicated: I'm talking about what you'd consider what makes a "good" partner out of someone.

g.title: j2225565895
g.text: MomToxicated: Well?

g.title: j4287721689
g.text: MomToxicated: Velimir is in love with the idea of love.

g.title: j3220829937
g.text: MomToxicated: Velimir and I are meant to be grown-ass adults. We are supposed to be capable of dealing with our own issues.

g.title: j2433336906
g.text: MomToxicated: Do you want Sol's honest truth?

g.title: j2087800920
g.text: MomToxicated: Now.

g.title: j1777763616
g.text: MomToxicated: WELL?!

g.title: j2511303627
g.text: MomToxicated: Not with me.

g.title: j2500528504
g.text: MomToxicated: So, for unintentionally adding to the pile of your daily stressors, I apologize, Drifter.

g.title: j3949058050
g.text: MomToxicated: He isn't "over" our marriage. Over... me, I suppose.

g.title: j3180390040
g.text: MomToxicated: You've met me.

g.title: j3442391635
g.text: MomToxicated: Screw this. I need some air. *Children.* The lot of you.

g.title: j1941731382
g.text: MomToxicated: And he never has been.

g.title: j635290203
g.text: MomToxicated: But here's the part of himself he won't accept.

g.title: j2829788418
g.text: MomToxicated: What do YOU think?

g.title: j3658374658
g.text: PapaPolar: ....

g.title: j3347170772
g.text: MomToxicated: ... Sigh.

g.title: j3824030677
g.text: Boolean MinervaBurden is now true.

g.title: j42126933
g.text: PapaPolar: ... really sorry about that...

g.title: j1436859462
g.text: MomToxicated: I'm sorry.

g.title: j1203856251
g.text: I'm sorry she treats you like that.

g.title: j922628781
g.text: Was she right...? Was that what you were going to say?

g.title: j2791142792
g.text: MomToxicated: I shouldn't have written that.

g.title: j4144095326
g.text: PapaPolar: is what it is...

g.title: j1873253576
g.text: PapaPolar: ... yeah.

g.title: j2515212170
g.text: PapaPolar: good thing she's my *ex* wife, right? hahaha.

g.title: j3980636384
g.text: PapaPolar: pretty much word for word, too.

g.title: j928911841
g.text: PapaPolar: sigh.

g.title: j263495981
g.text: PapaPolar: she knows me back to front, front to back. that's the problem with being married to a spy.

g.title: j892097101
g.text: It's clear you still have feelings for her, though.

g.title: j293450284
g.text: But it's not fair to you.

g.title: j3733825849
g.text: PapaPolar: especially one who's better at it than you are...

g.title: j2801899498
g.text: PapaPolar: but that's my job, isn't it? to have all the feelings in this relationship.

g.title: j1548334484
g.text: PapaPolar: sigh.

g.title: j3465379460
g.text: You think she's a better spy than you are?

g.title: j2374321385
g.text: Why were you going to crack a joke when you know it was going to make her mad?

g.title: j939511331
g.text: PapaPolar: i'm the one who held neci when she had her nightmares in the middle of the night.

g.title: j478937250
g.text: PapaPolar: when's life ever been fair?

g.title: j994273401
g.text: PapaPolar: she's better than me at everything. smarter. tougher. more capable.

g.title: j412802712
g.text: PapaPolar: i don't know. old habits, i guess... it's the only thing i've ever been good at. and it used to work

g.title: j1174803256
g.text: PapaPolar: i'm the one who had to talk neci down from putting out a revenge hit on her date that time she got stood up.

g.title: j979590689
g.text: PapaPolar: gotta go for a drink. talk soon.

g.title: j600725089
g.text: PapaPolar: i've always been a burden. only good for one thing. i used to make minerva laugh. and when that didn't work? i could always make neci smile

g.title: j3606057507
g.text: PapaPolar: no, M might have handled all the spreadsheets and travel arrangements.

g.title: j3141540772
g.text: PapaPolar: i could always get our little girl to laugh, no matter what had gone wrong. no matter how upset she was.

g.title: j1781442497
g.text: PapaPolar: (and where all the bodies got buried)

g.title: j865225245
g.text: PapaPolar: but now that she's gone?

g.title: j1277882736
g.text: PapaPolar: but it doesn't mean i didn't carry my share of the load. she just...didn't see value in that half, i suppose.

g.title: j2506511567
g.text: PapaPolar: why would a woman like minerva ever need an idiot like me around?

g.title: j2983121621
g.text: PapaPolar: but that's life, ain't it? you see blue. somebody else sees yellow.

g.title: j82274426
g.text: Boolean VelimirBurden is now true.

g.title: j1933267885
g.text: PapaPolar: just how we're wired up.

g.title: j688847690
g.text: Boolean MinervaBurdenV is now true.
